map.note: Actual swisstopo vector geometry, simplified for preview. Main roads cover the full extent; minor roads are retained around the office and local route destinations. Coordinates rounded to 5 decimal places. Building footprints retained near routes and the office; see building_source for selection.

building_source.note: Actual published building footprints near the route examples, selected by centroid within 140m of the road geometry or 350m of Kraken. Not a complete city building inventory. Exteriors counterclockwise and holes clockwise (RFC 7946). Simplified to 1.1m, coordinates rounded to six decimals.

routing.note: Precomputed route examples. Distances are for the returned fastest route in the stated direction, between snapped road positions. Estimates are not live traffic or a navigation guarantee. OSRM response did not expose data_version.
